# Product Categories

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List categories

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories`

Retrieve a paginated list of product categories with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: parent, children, creator, propertyAccountIncome, propertyAccountExpense, propertyAccountDownPayment | `parent,propertyAccountIncome` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by category name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[parent_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of parent IDs to filter by |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `name` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories?include=parent%2CpropertyAccountIncome&sort=name&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories?include=parent%2CpropertyAccountIncome&sort=name&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories?include=parent%2CpropertyAccountIncome&sort=name&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create category

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories`

Create a new product category with accounting properties

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Category name (max 255 characters). Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `parent_id` | integer | No | Parent category ID for nested categories. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_account_income_id` | integer | No | Income account ID for this category. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_account_expense_id` | integer | No | Expense account ID for this category. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `property_account_down_payment_id` | integer | No | Down payment account ID for this category. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Electronics",
  "parent_id": 1,
  "property_account_income_id": 1,
  "property_account_expense_id": 2,
  "property_account_down_payment_id": 3
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "Electronics",
  "parent_id": 1,
  "property_account_income_id": 1,
  "property_account_expense_id": 2,
  "property_account_down_payment_id": 3
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => 'Electronics',
    'parent_id' => 1,
    'property_account_income_id' => 1,
    'property_account_expense_id' => 2,
    'property_account_down_payment_id' => 3,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/categories"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

payload = {
    "name": "Electronics",
    "parent_id": 1,
    "property_account_income_id": 1,
    "property_account_expense_id": 2,
    "property_account_down_payment_id": 3,
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```
